description: Use when an agent must hand over a document as a PDF (report, invoice, summary, receipt). Input: GET ?url= for a public page, or POST JSON {html | markdown | url, format A4|Letter, landscape, margin_mm}. Markdown gets a clean stylesheet with Korean fonts. Output: JSON fileBase64 (decode to the PDF), bytes, page settings. Headless Chrome on Cloudflare. Bad input or daily cap refused before payment. Example: ?url=https://example.com/ Price: $0.01 USDC (Base or Solana) via x402.

html.description: HTML to render (MCP argument or POST JSON; alternative to url/markdown)

markdown.description: Markdown to render (MCP argument or POST JSON; alternative to url/html)

url.description: Public http(s) page to render (GET). For html/markdown use POST JSON.

name: render_pdf
title: Render to PDF: HTML, Markdown or a web page to a print-ready PDF (Korean fonts included)
